title: Assouad Dimensions and Spectra of Graphs of Weierstrass-Type Functions with Rapidly Growing Frequencies
summary: We study the Assouad dimension, lower dimension, and Assouad spectrum of graphs of the functions \(f(x)=\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}a_nφ(b_nx+θ_n)\), where \(φ\) is a nonconstant \(1\)-periodic \(C^2\) function, \(a_n,b_n>0\), \((θ_n)\) is an arbitrary real sequence, \(\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}a_n (2-α)/α\), the spectrum attains the general upper bound for \(α\)-Hölder graphs whenever \((2-α)/β_*\leq\vartheta 0\). When \(β_*=\infty\), this determines the complete spectrum. Together with Barański's formulas, our results yield graphs whose lower, Hausdorff, upper box, and Assouad dimensions are four distinct…
